scope_limits: Public official communications/index scan and targeted search, not exhaustive label-diff, spontaneous-report, manufacturer-letter or worldwide-regulator surveillance.
Search date filters returned old pages and crawler freshness; decisions use actual notice/publication/update dates and content.
Minute-level notice timing is not provided by most indexes; one-day overlap and broad search from Oct 10 were used.
No historical recall audit was repeated; no external action was taken.
CHMP annex remained unavailable; negative result is bounded to accessible sources.
FDA What’s New and AEMS latest-quarter index appeared in search results; they were corroborating search-only sources and are not counted among directly opened sources.
